notes: Filter: the cutoff setting in the patcher is now used (previously every Filter ran at 1000 Hz). A pot bound to cutoff now sweeps the full 60 Hz-16 kHz range, and turning it fully down gives the lowest cutoff instead of jumping back up. Speaker amp auto-idle is now OFF by default (turn it on per unit in the Audio Output inspector), and when on it only switches the amp on for patches that use the Speaker output. Includes all changes since 1.10.111.
